probeWorkflow:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/ci-push-concurrency-20261030]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || format('push-{0}', github.sha) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}


jobs:
  hold:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    steps:
      - name: Record actual push identity and hold overlapping runs
        run: |
          printf '%s %s %s\n' "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" "$GITHUB_SHA"
          sleep 90
scope: actual isolated branch pushes; not forced overlapping main pushes
